Hello everyone! Welcome all to my 6th Premiere (Real Time) video tutorial! This acrylic painting was done on a  9x12 inch canvas board. This is the uncut version. I hope you like what you see and possibly learn a thing or two if you desire to do so.

Brushes used:
¾ inch flat badger hair brush (for background)
#4 flat brush (for barnacles and underwater plant life and for painting the seals)
#3 round brush (for painting the seals and bubbles)
#2 script liner brush (for detail work)

Paints used:
Cadmium Red Deep Hue
Hansa Yellow
Carbon Black
Titanium White
Ultramarine Blue
Cadmium Orange Hue

If you would like to purchase a painting or commission me for portraits, pet portraits or any other drawings or paintings, please contact me directly at Rick@rjbartstudio.com or visit my website at:

videos.title: Goldfinch on a branch
videos.description:
I struggled with this one for a bit. The bird just did not want to cooperate lol. Finally got it right...whew! 

I did this one in acrylic paints on an 11x14 inch home-made wooden primed hardboard canvas. I will be making these canvas panels fit to any size specification and selling them for a very reasonable price. They will fit any standard sized picture frame by replacing the frame glass since it is the same thickness of the glass (1/8 inch thick). This is my preferred canvas since it is not only extremely archival but also offers a very smooth finish to allow for easier acrylic and oil painting experience.

If anyone is interested in buying them, I will be putting them up in my Etsy store in the near future. Link below. 

Etsy store link:
https://www.etsy.com/shop/RickJBerubeArtStudio 

For now you can go to my website to order them. Just send me a comment in my contact page and let me know size and quantity desired and I will give you a quote.

Drawing = graphite, colored pencil and makers
Shading = markers and acrylic paints
body of eagle and tree = acrylic paint

videos.title: Christmas Vigil Acrylic Painting And Tutorial
videos.description:
This painting was done on a 16 x 20 inch stretched canvas. I remember the days going to Christmas Vigil mass with my brother and parents. This acrylic painting was done with thoughts of bringing all some Christmas cheer and to give hope to all who are in need and to help us get through these pandemic times. We all need a little help from time to time.
There are lots of little details here including 10 people, a puppy, 1 modern Ram pickup truck, an older VW van, 6 buildings (not including the manger), 6 lamp posts & many trees.  
The life sized statutes in the manger includes: 2 sheep 3 Kings (wise men) and of course baby Jesus, Mary & Joseph all nestled in a manger perched in front of the church for towns folk to gaze upon. 

See how many objects / people you can find and post in the comments.

The Star-Spangled Banner lyrics:
O say can you see, by the dawn’s early light,
What so proudly we hail’d at the twilight’s last gleaming,
Whose broad stripes and bright stars through the perilous fight
O’er the ramparts we watch’d were so gallantly streaming?
And the rocket’s red glare, the bombs bursting in air,
Gave proof through the night that our flag was still there,
O say does that star-spangled banner yet wave
O’er the land of the free and the home of the brave?
On the shore dimly seen through the mists of the deep
Where the foe’s haughty host in dread silence reposes,
What is that which the breeze, o’er the towering steep,
As it fitfully blows, half conceals, half discloses?
Now it catches the gleam of the morning’s first beam,
In full glory reflected now shines in the stream,
’Tis the star-spangled banner - O long may it wave
O’er the land of the free and the home of the brave!
And where is that band who so vauntingly swore,
That the havoc of war and the battle’s confusion
A home and a Country should leave us no more?
Their blood has wash’d out their foul footstep’s pollution.
No refuge could save the hireling and slave
From the terror of flight or the gloom of the grave,
And the star-spangled banner in triumph doth wave
O’er the land of the free and the home of the brave.
O thus be it ever when freemen shall stand
Between their lov’d home and the war’s desolation!
Blest with vict’ry and peace may the heav’n rescued land
Praise the power that hath made and preserv’d us a nation!
Then conquer we must, when our cause it is just,
And this be our motto - “In God is our trust,” 
And the star-spangled banner in triumph shall wave
O’er the land of the free and the home of the brave.

videos.title: Christmas Vigil Acrylic Painting And Tutorial
videos.description:
This painting was done on a 16 x 20 inch stretched canvas. I remember the days going to Christmas Vigil mass with my brother and parents. This acrylic painting was done with thoughts of bringing all some Christmas cheer and to give hope to all who are in need and to help us get through these pandemic times. We all need a little help from time to time.
There are lots of little details here including 10 people, a puppy, 1 modern Ram pickup truck, an older VW van, 6 buildings (not including the manger), 6 lamp posts & many trees.  
The life sized statutes in the manger includes: 2 sheep 3 Kings (wise men) and of course baby Jesus, Mary & Joseph all nestled in a manger perched in front of the church for towns folk to gaze upon.

To see a time-lapse of this painting go to:

The wreath has significant meaning for the season. It's circular shape represents eternity, for it has no beginning and no end. From a christian religious perspective, it represents an unending circle of life. The evergreen, most frequently used in making wreathes, symbolizes growth and everlasting life.

videos.title: (Part 1) Color pencil drawing of "The Grinch Who Stole Christmas" with Jim Carrey
videos.description:
I love this movie and figured what better way to get into the Christmas spirit with none other than good ‘ol Jim Carrey. I thought he made the best Grinch and did a great job in the movie. Anyway, I hope you enjoy it as much as I did drawing him as the Grinch.

I used Prismacolor pencils and Ohuhu markers for this particular creation. 

Let me know what you thought in the comments. Please give me a like and subscribe if you liked this. I will be drawing many more like this one for all the holidays.
Merry Christmas & Happy Holidays!

Westcott 18 inch ruler
